facts.name: Stanford West Apartments
facts.pet_policy: Dogs and indoor cats allowed (restrictions apply); a monthly pet fee applies. Two dog-friendly parks nearby.
facts.parking: Unattached garage mentioned for 1-bedroom floor plans. Attached garage is an amenity.
facts.lease_terms: A premium of $200 per month applies to new leases and renewals with a duration of less than six to nine months. Lease renewal letters sent at least a month before expiration.
facts.international_or_no_ssn: Stanford affiliate rates are available to those who qualify for eligibility categories 1A thru 2B. Eligibility page has more information.
facts.notes: 628-unit residential community. Affiliate rental rates are updated annually in May. Below are the Affiliate Rate rental ranges for 2026. Prices shown are subject to change without notice and may vary depending upon location, floor level, and interior amenities.
